s.note: A guard offers another slice at the end. Crisp tray pizza with pepperoni and mozzarella.
s.how: Oil a large baking tray and press the dough out to the edges. Spread with passata seasoned with the oregano and a pinch of salt. Scatter over the mozzarella and pepperoni, then the parmesan. Bake at 240C until the base is crisp and the cheese is blistered. Cut into squares and serve hot.

s.n: Fiji kokoda cups with coconut and lime
s.note: Truman still dreams of getting to Fiji. Lime-cured fish in coconut cream with chilli.
s.how: Toss the fish with the juice of 3 limes and a pinch of salt and chill until it turns white. Drain off most of the lime juice. Stir in the coconut cream, chilli, cucumber, tomato and spring onion. Spoon into the lettuce cups and finish with the last lime.

m.note: Meryl made macaroni. Smoky ham macaroni under a gruyere crust.
m.how: Boil the macaroni until just short of tender and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, then whisk in the milk until thick. Take off the heat and stir in the mustard, cheddar and half the gruyere. Fold through the pasta and ham and tip into a baking dish. Top with the rest of the gruyere and the panko and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.

m.note: Truman sails into the painted sky. Snapper pie under buttery mash.
m.how: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with 50g butter and the warm milk. Soften the leek in 60g butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Stir in the fish, prawns, dill and lemon zest and tip into a baking dish. Spread over the mash, rough up the top with a fork and bake at 200C until golden.

w.note: Meryl pitches Mococoa in the middle of a fight. Rich cocoa custard under whipped cream.
w.how: Heat 300ml cream and the milk until steaming, then stir in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth. Whisk the yolks, sugar and vanilla, then whisk in the hot chocolate cream. Pour into 4 small cups in a deep tray, add hot water halfway up, and bake at 150C until just set with a wobble. Chill, then top with the rest of the cream, softly whipped.

d.note: Marlon holds the can right up to the camera. Ice-cold American lager in the can.
d.how: Chill the cans on ice until very cold. Hand them out with a straight face and the label facing the room.
